attempt_seq.description: Runner-assigned order within the slot, allocated before launch.

build_refs.description: Build attempts used, one per build requirement of the slot.
Build attempts actually used, one per build requirement.

ExternalKey.description:
A producer-chosen external key (`regression_ref`, `slot_ref`, ...): 1–200 characters of
`[A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]`, unique within `(project, producer, kind)`.

UtcTime.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z

Purpose.description: Production or experiment (experiments are reserved; 0.1 rejects them).

BuildReqRef.description: A build requirement reference: the source and the build configuration.

BuildConfig.description: A build configuration (what is compiled and how).

uvm_version.description: UVM version, when UVM is used.

file_list_digest.description: Digest of the file list, when the flow can supply it.

Simulator.description: Simulator identity, part of build configuration.

Runner.description: Runner facts, measured by the supervisor (never by the log).

wall_s.description: Wall time from a monotonic clock, seconds.

peak_rss_kb.description: Peak resident set of the largest single process, KiB.

exit_code.description: Exit code, when the process exited.

posix_signal.description: POSIX signal number, when one ended it.

oneOf.description: Stopped by the runner for another reason.
Stopped by something else (signal, OOM killer, user).
Ended by a fault (SIGSEGV, access violation, abort).
The supervisor could not record how it ended.

Measure.description: A non-negative decimal measure with an optional fraction, as a string (`"812.4"`).

CpuScope.description: What a CPU time figure covers.

oneOf.description: The child and the children it waited for (Linux `wait4`).

PeakScope.description: What a peak memory figure covers.

oneOf.description: The largest single process of the supervised tree.

evidence_revision.description: Evidence revision: advanced only by re-extraction (always 1 in 0.1).

reconciliation.description: Reconciliations of summary counters with extracted events.

Extractor.description: Identity of the extractor that produced the evidence.

Source.description: The source bytes the evidence describes.

log_name.description: File name of the log (no directories).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes (hex), computed by the extractor.

invalid_utf8_bytes.description: Number of invalid UTF-8 bytes replaced.

segments.description:
The streams the log joins, in order (a Verilator model with its own main: the
program log, then the console), contiguous and covering every byte; absent for a
single stream.

LineEnding.description: Line ending found in the source.

LogSegment.description:
One stream of a joined log: its bytes (half-open) and lines (1-based, inclusive, global
over the joined log; both null for an empty segment).

line_start.description: First line, or null when the segment holds no line.

line_end.description: Last line, or null when the segment holds no line.

LogSegmentName.description: Which stream a segment of the log comes from.

Completion.description: Completion of the log against its profile.

sections_seen.description: Required sections seen, in order (completion witness).

verdict_required.description: Whether the profile requires a positive verdict source (outcome row 9).

oneOf.description: Every required component of the profile was seen.
Something required is missing or was cut.
A recorded fatal and the simulator trailer.

CompletionReason.description: Why a log is not complete.

oneOf.description: A line was cut inside a failure record or required section.
The log could not be read.
The supervisor could not record the termination.
No profile applies (unknown simulator or kind).

A Verilator model with its own main: the log is not the program log and console
joined by the collector.

A Verilator model with its own main printed Verilator's own simulation report (or ran
under another simulator): it is not a custom-main run.

The run declares its own main but no project pack of the pipeline declares the
model's markers.
The model's console witnesses are out of order.
A console witness of the model is missing or repeated (one execution per attempt).
A console witness appears in the program log, or a console verdict after the finish.
The producer's reported outcome (normalized by the server).

Span.description: A byte and line span in the original log.

Counter.description: A counter read from a summary.

key.description: Key within the domain (severity, ID, check name).

value.description: Value, exact, as a decimal string (summaries can exceed 2^53).

protected.description: Whether no rule may claim or suppress it.

explained_by.description:
The diagnostic ID whose failing buckets account for this failure count (a check row
of a project report), when the pack declares one.

DecimalInteger.description: A non-negative decimal integer of up to 39 digits, as a string (seeds, large counters).

oneOf.description: Counts failures; > 0 is a failure indication.

count.description: Exact count, as a decimal string.

example_ordinal.description: Ordinal of a retained example, if any.

Provenance.description: Where a bucket's failure indication comes from.

oneOf.description: Recognized by the fixed protected pre-pass; cannot be suppressed as a failure.
Matched by a pack or project rule.
Created by DVIScope (runner facts, evaluator, expectations).

buckets.description: Indices into `Evidence::buckets` of this family's buckets.

OverflowEntry.description: Overflow accounting, exact by outcome-relevant dimensions.

count.description: Exact count, as a decimal string.

message_raw.description: Message as written (may contain personal data; never in URLs or metrics).

fields.description: Typed fields parsed from the record.

EventProvenance.description: Where an example event came from.

FieldValue.description: A typed field value parsed from a diagnostic.

oneOf.description: A SystemVerilog number literal as written (`32'hdead_beef`, `4'b10x1`).

SourceAnchor.description: A source location named by a diagnostic.

path.description: Path as written (never resolved by the core).

oneOf.description: Truncated by the tool (e.g. leading `..`); never treated as resolved.

Normalization.description: One normalization applied to a message or field.

count.description: Lines suppressed, exact, as a decimal string.

Coverage.description: Parser coverage: error-like lines no rule claimed.

unclaimed_error_like_lines.description: Count of unclaimed error-like lines, as a decimal string.

LogResources.description: Resource figures read from the simulator log (the runner's figures are in `Runner`).

cycles.description: Simulated cycles, when the log reports them.

oneOf.description: Read from the simulator's own log lines.

Cycles.description: Simulated cycles and the clock they count.

value.description: Cycle count, as a decimal string.

clock.description: Name of the clock or counter behind the figure.

Reconciliation.description: One reconciliation of summary counters with extracted events.

counted.description: Sum of the template's counters, as a decimal string.

extracted.description: Extracted events of the template's population (observed, before suppression).

holds.description: Whether the relation holds (a violation makes completion `count_mismatch`).

oneOf.description: Extracted ≤ counted (a summary may count messages it did not print).

ExecInputs.description: Exact execution inputs of a slot.

plusargs.description: Plusargs and run options, exactly as given and in order.

elaboration_modes.description: Modes that belong to elaboration (e.g. `-voptargs`), used for elaboration groups.

AttemptResult.description: Result part of a simulation attempt.

ReportedOutcome.description: Outcome as the producer reported it (one input of outcome derivation, never the outcome).

ArtifactRef.description: An artifact reference: never fetched, previewed or probed.

Ext.description: Namespaced extension data (namespace.name keys); numbers must be integers within +/-(2^53-1)
